items.html: Afterwards, when the Emanator wanted to correct them, He raised the vessels in Atzilut, too, in an order of three lines. Then, when they were made in the state of lines, came the first Ibur [impregnation] of ZON, and a second correction was added, as the lights came inside the vessels. However, it was still only in the state of three lines, which we call three contained in three. Then they expanded in the form of VAK during the Yenika, and after that, at the time of the Mochin, all ten vessels were completed. There was another change: In the beginning, before there was any Ibur, when there was not even the first Ibur of ZON, but only a restricted light in the vessel, afterwards, the vessel expanded in the form of a complete Partzuf in order to diminish the light, as this is the primary intention of the correction.
